connectors.name: UART0-OUT 4-pin connector
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers. Start at the end closest to the USB connector (right end; USB-5V-IN connector is on the right edge of the board). Legend box to the left of J2 read left to right as pads left to right.

connectors.name: UART1-OUT 4-pin connector
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers. Start at the end closest to the USB connector (right end). Legend box to the left of J12 read left to right as pads left to right.

connectors.name: I2C-OUT 4-pin connector
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers. Start at the end closest to the USB connector (right end). Legend box to the left of J13 read left to right as pads left to right.

connectors.name: UART0-IN 4-pin connector
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers. Start at the end closest to the USB connector (right end). Legend printed directly above the pads.

connectors.name: Wireless module 2x7 header (right)
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers (small dot by top-left pad not labeled 1). 2xN rule: start at bottom end (closer to the USB connector on the right edge), outer column = right column (nearer the right board edge), alternating. Labels from the 2x7 legend box beside J11, legend columns/rows mapped to pad columns/rows in the same orientation.

connectors.name: Wireless module 2x7 header (left)
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers or labels. 2xN rule as for J11: bottom end first, right column first, alternating.

connectors.name: BAT 2-pin connector
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers. Start at the end closest to the USB connector (right end). '+' printed at right, '-' at left of the connector.

connectors.name: SPK 2-pin connector
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers. Start at the end closest to the USB connector (right end). '+' printed at right, '-' at left, below the connector.

unreadable: J11: the wireless-module legend font does not distinguish letter O from digit 0, so the 'IO' prefixes are recorded with 0 (I020, I05, I04, I06, I019, I016, I015, I02, I00). On J2/J12/J13/J10 the slashed zero makes IO and RX0/TX0 distinguishable.
J9 positions 1-14: no labels printed for this 2x7 header.
uncertain: Wireless module legend (14 names, 2x7) is printed only beside J11; assigning it to J11 rather than J9, and mapping its columns/rows to J11's pads in the same orientation, is inferred. J9 is left unlabeled.
J2, J12 and J13 legends are printed in a box beside each connector, not over the pads; left-to-right legend order mapped to left-to-right pads by inference.
J3 (BAT) and J14 (SPK): the '+' and '-' marks are printed beside/below the connector body; assigning them to the right and left pads is inferred.
notes: Rendered PCB view (CrowPanel ESP32 Display-5.0 inch Advance_series, SKU DIS02050A V1.0). Skipped: USB-5V-IN, TF card slot, MIC and FPC2 footprints (no individual pin labels), BOOT/RESET buttons, function-select switch table and I2S/IIC text notes (no pin positions).
